title: AXON - Accessible Design system
description: A test of how far AI can take accessible design systems, built with a fully AI-assisted workflow from Figma Make to Figma MCP/Claude to Storybook.

title: Agent-Readiness checker
description: Figma's AI agent buried my fixes in a chat log I'd forget by the third message. This shows me right on the canvas: what's broken, why, and how to fix it.

title: Building Adaptive Teams
description: A fictional microlearning course to emulate the ADDIE process of learning design.
